label: late copy-phase steps (recall_idx >= 5) shortly after h/d/i/3/b/m/2
explanation: Almost entirely a copy-phase feature (99.8% of mass): it fires late in the copy, when recalling original position 5 or later (recall_idx>=5 covers 95% of activations and 98% of mass), and most often on the last 1-2 outputs (to_go=0 holds 54% of mass). It essentially never fires in the original phase, at the delimiter, or on early copy steps (recall_idx<=4). Within late copy steps the firing depends on tokens: rate is highest when the previous input (or the one two steps back) was h, d or i (prev_tok h/d/i alone gives precision 0.81), and to a lesser degree 3, b, m or 2. The top activations come right after an h or d input that fires weakly, then peak on the next token. Recency predicate: dev F1 0.57, mass recall 0.80. Position alone gives high recall but precision of only about 0.3, so the token dependence is real but only partly captured.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the previous input (most: h, d, i, 3, b, m; least: w, <DEL>, q, n) and the input two steps back (most: i, d, h, 2, 3, l; least: w, z, n, <DEL>); timing cues that raise it most: L=4 & t=7, recall_idx=6, recall_idx=5.
